title: Vibrant Smoked Turkish Lamb Kebabs
description: Savory, crisp Turkish lamb kebabs featuring a smoky flavor with dried chillies. This recipe is perfect for a lazy Sunday roast with low-sodium options.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together smoked paprika, crushed dried chillies, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the spice mixture.
Thread the lamb onto skewers, leaving a 1-inch space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and grill for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, prepare the wood chips for the robata grill by soaking them in water for at least 30 minutes prior to use.
After flipping the kebabs, add the wood chips to the grill and close the lid to create a smoky flavor.
Remove the kebabs from the grill and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon juice.
